# Operators

<!-- Generated by `mise run catalog:generate` from examples/catalog/: edit the entries, not this file. -->

Operators are classes Blender calls back (`execute`, `invoke`, `modal`, `poll`) and that scripts call through
`bpy.ops` by idname. What their callbacks must return, what a call through `bpy.ops` accepts, and what the strings that
name an operator have to match.
